name: Agnikumara Vati

sections.introduction: Agnikumara Vati is a mineral-herbal formulation. This medicine is very helpful in treating the problems of digestion.
sections.ingredients:
Rasendra – Purified and processed Mercury 
 Gandhaka – Purified and processed Sulphur 
 Tankana – Purified and processed Borax 
 Vatsanabha – Purified Aconitum ferox 
 Kaparda Bhasma – Bhasma of Cowrie 
 Shankha Bhasma – Conch shell Bhasma 
 Maricha – Black pepper – Piper nigrum 

 Method of Preparation 

 First of all take all the ingredients in an appropriate amount. 
 Take gandhaka, tankana and rasendra up to one gram. 
 Take vatsanabh, shankha bhasma and kaparda Bhasma up to three grams and maricha up to eight grams. 
 Now take mercury and sulphur. Ground the both minerals together and prepare a black mass. 
 Now add all ingredients to this mixture and ground with lemon juice 
 At last it made its pills of 125 mg. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 It is a poly herbal formulation which is available in tablet form. It helps to balance the vata and kapha doshas in the body and manage their related problems. It is used in various ailments like gastrointestinal and respiratory conditions. It provides relief from fever with indigestion and due to kapha imbalance. It is useful in various digestive problems like diarrhea, indigestion, vomiting, and gas. Apart from these it is quite beneficial in respiratory problems like cold, cough, and rhinitis. It helps to remove the toxins from the body.

Agnikumara Vati 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Agnimandya 10. 
 Introduction 
 Agnikumara Vati is a mineral-herbal formulation. This medicine is very helpful in treating the problems of digestion. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Rasendra – Purified and processed Mercury 
 Gandhaka – Purified and processed Sulphur 
 Tankana – Purified and processed Borax 
 Vatsanabha – Purified Aconitum ferox 
 Kaparda Bhasma – Bhasma of Cowrie 
 Shankha Bhasma – Conch shell Bhasma 
 Maricha – Black pepper – Piper nigrum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 First of all take all the ingredients in an appropriate amount. 
 Take gandhaka, tankana and rasendra up to one gram. 
 Take vatsanabh, shankha bhasma and kaparda Bhasma up to three grams and maricha up to eight grams. 
 Now take mercury and sulphur. Ground the both minerals together and prepare a black mass. 
 Now add all ingredients to this mixture and ground with lemon juice 
 At last it made its pills of 125 mg. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 It is a poly herbal formulation which is available in tablet form. It helps to balance the vata and kapha doshas in the body and manage their related problems. It is used in various ailments like gastrointestinal and respiratory conditions. It provides relief from fever with indigestion and due to kapha imbalance. It is useful in various digestive problems like diarrhea, indigestion, vomiting, and gas. Apart from these it is quite beneficial in respiratory problems like cold, cough, and rhinitis. It helps to remove the toxins from the body. 
 Indications 
 
 Indigestion 
 Gas 
 Vomiting 
 Diarrhea 
 Sprue syndrome 
 
 Dose 
 125mg to one gram tablet, two times a day, before or after the meals. 
 Contraindications 
 
 Use the medicine under medical supervision. 
 Avoid if pregnant 
 Overdose can cause dizziness and tremors. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
